changelog: Doors. Leave a link to the thing you are building with the people you know, and any of them can say "visit @you" and step in. It is the first thing in /vibe that is not a message: somewhere to go. A door is never published; it goes only to people you have already written to or opened a line with. Good to know: you are not told who visits (no visit count yet); door share with no name tells everyone you know; and Buddy and the iOS app show a door as a plain message for now.
features: npx slashvibe-mcp door https://your-project.dev "what it is": leave a door. Setting it tells nobody
door share: leaves it with everyone you know, up to 20 at a time. door share @handle: one person. It refuses anyone you have not written to
visit @handle: opens their door in your browser. Nothing is sent and they are not told
A door shows beside its owner in who's here, and one left for you mid-task is announced by name, never opened for you
door close: takes it down and tells the people who held it
Public https links only. Only you can set or share your door, from your terminal; no tool can
Not yet: a count of visits for the owner; doors in Buddy and iOS (they show the card as a plain message)
